fields.source: Android runtime camera permission; observed route authority design/pages/recognition/README.md and app/src/main/java/com/yujian/ai/ui/screens/IdentifyScreen.kt
fields.fallback: Permission-denied state; Gallery may be offered through the independent picker route.
fields.error_behavior: Do not start preview or capture. Exact denial/settings copy stays unresolved under CAP-003.

fields.fallback: CAMERA_UNAVAILABLE; retain Gallery and Back recovery.
fields.error_behavior: Do not create a partial image or enter Processing.

fields.source: Camera or Gallery selection normalized at Identify handoff; master flow capture_camera/capture_gallery
fields.fallback: No image selected keeps the page in EMPTY/READY.
fields.error_behavior: Unreadable media stays on Capture with a retryable Gallery/camera path.
Failed normalization remains in a recoverable capture state; no FishRecord is written.

coverage.empty: No still image committed: remain on Capture; no recognition or record is started.
coverage.loading: Permission, provider initialization, capture and picker handoff are separate loading states; prevent duplicate capture.
coverage.error: Permission/provider/read failure remains recoverable; exact UI copy and camera visual are blocked.
coverage.partial: A picker selection that cannot be decoded is not treated as a usable partial image.
coverage.network_failure: NOT_APPLICABLE: Capture has no registered network data dependency. A later pipeline connectivity failure is handled by Processing as a technical failure only if reported by the pipeline.

field_lineage_status: Camera runtime source is identified; Gallery/permission UX is not fully page-authorized.
policy: System permission and Photo Picker remain platform-owned. Camera permission is required only for the camera stream; Gallery remains independent. No backend/API schema is asserted.
